entries.headline: Built a read-only unified Gmail inbox
entries.summary: Implemented a local Next.js inbox that connects multiple Gmail accounts with readonly OAuth, incremental synchronization, encrypted refresh tokens, searchable messages, sanitized message viewing, and attachment downloads.

entries.headline: Added AI inbox triage and filtering
entries.summary: Added sync-time message classification with categories, job outcomes, and reply, deadline, sender, and payment flags. Results are stored with confidence distributions and exposed through inbox filters and relabeling endpoints.

entries.headline: Added citation-backed inbox RAG chat
entries.summary: Implemented an Ask panel that indexes cleaned email content, combines vector and full-text retrieval with reranking, and uses Claude tools to answer questions with citations to specific emails.
